findings.text: the goal's near-linear half and done_when clause (1) are unmet - the read stays superlinear (exponent ~1.47, 80.6 s warm versus the base 79.2 s) and the component-label propagation was not bounded; the node substitutes a widened admission for the named propagation bound and defers the wall to follow-on f-cfs-read-warm-wall.

the done-when clause (3) 1e-13 identity block runs only when backend=="cpu", so the final-head H200 arm (suite-final-rerun) skipped it; the head identity rests on head-cpu-identity-six.log at revision 34df9ac81, three commits before the reviewed head, and the final-head CPU run (final-policy-cpu.log at 061cd78fc) exercised only the two admission controls.

six binary goldens (limited/diverted at 550, 2000, 5000 without the -cpu suffix) are committed but referenced by nothing in the tree - git grep finds no reader and tests/test_read_ten_thousand_cells.py:61 loads only *-cpu.npz - so they are orphaned artifacts.

the declared negative-control string is 'restoring the base label propagation reproduces UNRESOLVED_COMPONENT at 10,000 cells by test id', but the head ships the base propagation, so that mutation is a no-op at head; the applied control reverts the membership admission scaling and reddens test_membership_overfill_respects_edge_tolerance, so the declared string names a lever that no longer distinguishes head from base.
